title: Caroline Jackson
clean_html:
Caroline Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksonc.htm

Caroline Jackson was the daughter of Robert B. Jackson and Lydia Ann Wright. She was born in Sussex Co., DE. in 1877 and she died there on 13 July, 1961. Caroline married Elwood Wright, the son of David Wright and Emily Johnson and they had the following children: Reba Wright Robert Wright Marshall Wright (1904-1926) Wesley Arthur Wright Alberta Wright, married William Andrew HARMON Agnes Wright Charles Wright , married Lillian Draine Herschel Wright Caroline and her husband were founding members of the Nanticoke Indian Association. photo in C.A. Weslager's book : The Nanticoke Indians: A Refugee Tribal Group of Pennsylvania Elwood Wright working on a yellow pine split eel pot. photo from: A Photographic Survey of Indian River Community by Frank Porter III
